solana_news.title: Slot Time Reduction Effects
solana_news.description: Solana is now producing slots with a 250ms target, going down from 400ms. In this article we study the effects of this reduction based on direct on-chain measures.

solana_news.title: Solana Foundation Appoints Rachel Conlan as Chief Strategy Officer and Jamal Raees as General Manager of Payments
solana_news.description: The Solana Foundation appointed Rachel Conlan to lead strategy and Jamal Raees to expand global payments adoption.

solana_news.title: Stocks Go Onchain: What the SEC's Innovation Exemption Means for Solana
solana_news.description: A five-year SEC order lets tokenized shares with full rights trade on public blockchains without stock-exchange registration; Solana's architecture is live.

solana_news.title: Solana Changelog: September 18, 2026
solana_news.description: Transaction V1 reaches mainnet as Solana targets 250ms slots, lower rent, and program deployments with four times lower fees.

solana_news.description: A ~$116 million Coldcard exploit shows why crypto security must eliminate single points of failure and automate defenses for AI-speed threats.
